title: The Moonlight Dinghy
story: After dark, under a thin December moon, Felix found his own dinghy gone from its slip. The tide was high and the causeway under water, so anyone who reached Thimble Point that evening got there by boat, and the dinghy was the only boat missing. Five people admit they were down by the water, each at a different spot, arriving at a different time, by a different light. Who went where, when, and by which light?

question.text: Who rowed out to Thimble Point after dark?

texts: Linus brought either a headlamp or a bike light.
Of Jonah and the person who arrived at 7:40 p.m., one brought a headlamp and the other brought a penlight.
Of Mabel and the person at the Point, one arrived at 8:00 p.m. and the other arrived at 7:20 p.m.
Of Zeke and the person at the beach, one arrived at 8:20 p.m. and the other arrived at 7:20 p.m.
The person at the slipway arrived at either 7:00 p.m. or 7:40 p.m.
The person with the headlamp arrived 20 minutes after the person with the penlight.
The person at the Point arrived exactly 60 minutes after the person at the pier.
The person with the lantern arrived at either 7:00 p.m. or 7:20 p.m.

trace.text: Clue 1 limits the choices (mark the X's it gives).

Clue 6 means the headlamp cannot be 7:00 p.m. and the penlight cannot be 8:20 p.m.
Clue 7 means the Point cannot be 7:00 p.m., 7:20 p.m., or 7:40 p.m. and the pier cannot be 7:40 p.m., 8:00 p.m., or 8:20 p.m.
Clue 2 limits the choices (mark the X's it gives).
Clue 3 limits the choices (mark the X's it gives).
The Point must go with 8:00 p.m.: clue 7 rules out 7:00 p.m., 7:20 p.m., and 7:40 p.m.; clue 3 rules out 8:20 p.m.
Mabel must go with 7:20 p.m.: clue 3 rules out 7:00 p.m., 7:40 p.m., and 8:20 p.m.; 8:00 p.m. is already ruled out for the Point.
Since the Point can still be only 8:00 p.m. and the pier can still be only 7:00 p.m. or 7:20 p.m., clue 7 means the pier cannot be 7:20 p.m.
The pier must go with 7:00 p.m.: clue 7 rules out 7:20 p.m., 7:40 p.m., 8:00 p.m., and 8:20 p.m.
The slipway must go with 7:40 p.m.: clue 5 rules out 7:20 p.m., 8:00 p.m., and 8:20 p.m.; 7:00 p.m. already goes with the pier.
Clue 4 limits the choices (mark the X's it gives).
Zeke must go with 8:20 p.m.: clue 4 rules out 7:00 p.m., 7:40 p.m., and 8:00 p.m.; 7:20 p.m. already goes with Mabel.
Zeke must go with the seawall: clue 4 rules out the beach; the Point is already ruled out for 8:00 p.m.; the pier is already ruled out for 7:00 p.m.; the slipway is already ruled out for 7:40 p.m.
Mabel must go with the beach: clue 3 rules out the Point; the pier and the slipway are already ruled out for 7:20 p.m.; the seawall already goes with Zeke.
7:20 p.m. goes with Mabel, so 7:20 p.m. also goes with the beach.
The seawall must go with 8:20 p.m.: the other choices are already taken.
SUPPOSE TEST: try Jonah with the penlight.
chain: Suppose Jonah goes with the penlight.
The slipway must go with the headlamp: the flashlight, the lantern, and the bike light are already ruled out for 7:40 p.m.; the penlight is already ruled out for Jonah.
7:40 p.m. goes with the slipway, so 7:40 p.m. also goes with the headlamp.
But then clue 6 cannot be true.
trace.result: So Jonah does NOT go with the penlight: mark that X.
